evals.name: edit-structure
evals.prompt: Edit the library's author schema and save the revised structure only when the reader chooses Save.
assertions: Feeds onChange back to schema state.
Uses onSave for persistence instead of saving every draft change.

evals.name: edit-values
evals.prompt: Edit an author document under a fixed schema. Disable Save for invalid field values.
evals.expected_output: ObjectContentEditor edits Json data under the supplied JsonSchema.
assertions: Sets editMode, not editable, on ObjectContentEditor.
Controls object through onChange without modifying schema.
Disables Save when onValidationChange reports true.

evals.name: cancel-draft
evals.prompt: A host passes every SchemaEditor draft back as schema. Explain what Cancel can restore and how to retain the originally loaded schema.
evals.expected_output: Keep the initial schema separate for a full reset.
assertions: Identifies the current schema prop as the cancel baseline.
Does not promise Cancel will restore an older loaded value.
Keeps the original separately if the caller needs a full reset.
